# formal_resource_ssh_host_key (Resource)

Pin an upstream SSH host public key for a Formal resource. Multiple pins may exist for one resource_id when the host presents multiple key types.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key of the upstream SSH host (for example the output of `ssh-keygen -yf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key`).
- `resource_id` (String) Resource ID for which the SSH host key is pinned.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the SSH host key pin.
